items.source: Generally speaking, @BeforeTransaction methods must not accept any arguments. However, for tests using the SpringExtension with JUnit Jupiter, @BeforeTransaction methods may optionally accept arguments which will be resolved by any registered JUnit ParameterResolver extension such as the SpringExtension. This means that JUnit-specific arguments like TestInfo or beans from the test's ApplicationContext may be provided to @BeforeTransaction methods analogous to @BeforeEach methods.
items.translation: 通常来说，@BeforeTransaction 方法不应接受任何参数。但是，对于使用 JUnit Jupiter 的 SpringExtension 进行测试时，@BeforeTransaction 方法可以可选地接受参数，这些参数将由任何已注册的 JUnit ParameterResolver 扩展（例如 SpringExtension）解析。这意味着可以像对待 @BeforeEach 方法一样，向 @BeforeTransaction 方法提供 JUnit 特定参数（如 TestInfo）或测试的 ApplicationContext 中的 Bean。

items.source: @BeforeTransaction methods declared in superclasses or as interface default methods will be executed before those of the current test class.
items.translation: @BeforeTransaction 方法在父类或作为接口默认方法声明时，将在当前测试类的相应方法之前执行。

items.source: This annotation may be used as a meta-annotation to create custom composed annotations.
items.translation: 此注解可用作 元注解 来创建自定义的 组合注解。
